this_court: Treats a second-in-time § 2254 petition filed while a first-in-time petition is pending on appeal as successive, so the district court lacked jurisdiction; the court does not construe it as a motion to amend.
quote: Because we disagree, we join the majority of our sister circuits to address this issue and AFFIRM the district court's dismissal of Rivers's second-in-time petition for lack of jurisdiction.
